knownGaps: Windows WPF build and UI tests cannot run in this Linux environment.
Deactivation (is_active=0) of base-data records has no UI yet; only create and rename are exposed.
Write buttons are not hidden for roles without base.manage (the service rejects the write).
Export is CSV only; no .xlsx writer exists in the runtime (ExcelDataReader is read-only).
DPAPI decryption of staged payloads is verified only on Windows (BLK-001).
Sorting hard rejection limit is an operator parameter (contract defines no numeric threshold)
Partnership Excel profile 11_Partnership is not yet converted into share rows (arithmetic + apply only)
OperationalWindows.cs weighing screen still uses hardcoded colours
Returned/cancelled cheque reversal journal is not generated yet
Documents created before schema v7 with requires_journal=0 have no journal entry yet; AccountingWindow can create it
EXPENSE and WASTE document types have no dedicated module yet
Second display shows KPIs only; a dedicated hall layout (very large type, no scrolling) needs owner approval (O-13)
Scheduled backup (reason SCHEDULED) has the schema and service support but no real scheduler; lands with the Windows task in G12
Windows build, installer compilation and UI run are still not executed (BLK-001)
Installer and executable are not code-signed (O-16)
.NET Framework 4.8 is a manual prerequisite; the installer does not provision it (O-17)

blockers.title: Windows build environment unavailable
blockers.detail: No .NET SDK, MSBuild or C# compiler exists in this Linux sandbox; WPF .NET Framework 4.8 cannot be compiled or UI-tested here.
blockers.resolution: Owner must build with MSBuild/Visual Studio 2022 + .NET Framework 4.8 Developer Pack on Windows 8.1/10/11 x64.

blockers.title: Real source workbooks not available
blockers.detail: The private source Excel workbooks (sources/) are deliberately excluded from the runtime package; only blank templates and the audit docs are available.
blockers.resolution: Owner must provide the real source workbooks (or approve structure extraction from the blank templates and documented rules).
